Bramble Meridian Starting Blade Guide

Game: Bramble Meridian. In Bramble Meridian, starting blade combat tactics begin with a dependable weapon.

Use the starting blade during an enemy recovery window and keep stamina for a dodge. Practice its quick strike against a single enemy before approaching a group. This starting blade can remain equipped while exploring the opening area.
